android.desc:
"BookShelf" is a mobile-only app that allows you to manage your books simply and effectively. With this app, you can enjoy the following main features:

Title search registration and barcode registration:
You can easily and quickly register your book by manually entering the book title. Find your favorite books and add them to your Book Shelf.

Simple design and ease of use:
BookShelf has an intuitive and easy-to-use design.
You can easily manage your books without complicated procedures or unnecessary functions.

Organize your book collection and enjoy a great reading experience with BookShelf.
Replace your cumbersome physical bookshelf with BookShelf's digital space.
Try the app and experience the ease of book management.

*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*=*
In the future, we plan to add custom tags and sorting options for books.
